reviewer: Pickle: official-source review of the Korea Consumer Agency comparison report 2025-19 on running jackets (published 2025-11-05), read with its attachment PDFs on 2026-11-20, plus the three Coupang listings opened live on 2026-11-20
method: Compared the draft against the consumer24 comparison page (infoId=A1081164) and attachment 1 (test overview and product table), attachment 2 (results), attachment 5 (summary table) downloaded on 2026-11-20: the 2025-03 survey of 1,500 jacket buyers, the eight tested models with prices (Nike Repel Miller 115,000, New Balance 99,900, Descente 199,000, Adidas Adizero Essential 89,000, Andar 119,000, Under Armour 109,000, Xexymix 119,000, Fila 189,000 won), thermal retention measured on a thermal manikin at 15 degrees and 63 percent with 1.8 m/s frontal wind and the 14.8 percent average loss with four products at two stars and four at one star, the 73 percent gain over a short-sleeve tee, air permeability ratings (New Balance, Adidas and Xexymix at three stars, the other five at two), the water-repellency drop to grade 3 after five washes for New Balance, Descente, Adidas and Under Armour while Nike, Andar, Xexymix and Fila held grade 5, the 2,000-cycle zipper against a 500-cycle reference, pilling and colour-fastness results, safety limits (pH 4.0-9.0, formaldehyde 300 mg/kg, arylamine 30 mg/kg) with PFOA and PFOS not detected, recycled material in four products and four packages, weights 173 to 243 g with the 70 g spread, thickness 0.14 to 0.28 mm, the one packable design, three hooded models, five mesh-ventilated models, and the washing note (76.6 percent machine washing, three hand-wash markings, two makers replying they will review). The korea.kr policy briefing of 2025-11-05 was read for the consumer-agency statement that thermal retention and air permeability pull in opposite directions. Coupang was checked in the signed-in browser on 2026-11-20: Adidas IT7585 at 62,100 won from 99,000 plus 2,500 won shipping, size A/L, two left, seller E-Land Retail NC Guro, no reviews; Nike DD4747-010 at 64,100 won from 123,800, 14 reviews, rocket-direct from China, arrival 11-25; Under Armour 1376795-026 at 57,920 won from 87,750, 12 reviews, size M in grey, one left, arrival 11-23. Fila's price is taken from the summary-table PDF at 189,000 won (the web page carries 119,000 in one table, so the article avoids quoting the page figure). All three AFFSDP deep links were tested and returned 302 to the intended product pages with lptag AF6593875. The affiliate block sits in one place after the FAQ with no top, inline or sticky box, per the 2026-11-17 approval-first layout, and the article states that colour codes and sizes differ from the tested units. | 2026-11-27 08:16 KST 7일 정기 재확인: 소비자원 비교공감 페이지·첨부 원문 7개 출처의 접속 상태를 다시 확인했고(쿠팡 3건은 로그인 없이 403 응답으로 접근 차단되나 상품 페이지 자체는 유지), 본문·조사 기록·승인 해시가 그대로임을 확인해 검증 시각만 갱신했다.
